id.description: The block's permanent identity inside its document; clients generate an 8-character random id.

revision.description: Output only: CID of the last Change that replaced this block, filled in by the daemon when serving.

type.description: The block type, such as `Paragraph` or `Image`; any string is accepted.

text.description: The block's plain text, for types that have text; formatting lives in `annotations`.

link.description: The block's one link: an `hm://`, `ipfs://`, `https://` or `nostr:` URL depending on the type.

annotations.description: Inline formatting, links and mentions over code-point ranges of `text`.

attributes.description: Type-specific attributes, nested here by the Seed API and SDK; on the wire they sit at the block's top level.

description: The open wire block: `id` and `type` plus text, link, annotations and any attributes, so unknown block types still parse.
